latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the qBittorrent skill.

- Manage torrents using qBittorrent's WebUI API (v4.1+)
- Supports listing, adding, pausing, resuming, deleting, and rechecking torrents
- Provides quick commands for filtering by status or category
- Includes global transfer stats, speed limit controls, and torrent metadata management (categories/tags)
- Offers detailed reference for setup and usage in SKILL.md
